description: This file defines the RuleChainRepository interface for accessing and querying RuleChainEntity objects in a SQL database, including custom queries for filtering by tenant, type, resource, and relations.

classes.name: RuleChainRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for RuleChainEntity with custom query methods for filtering and retrieving rule chains based on various criteria.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds rule chains by tenant ID with optional search text filtering, returns a paginated result.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds rule chains by tenant ID and type with optional search text filtering, returns a paginated result.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Finds rule chains associated with a specific edge ID, with optional search text filtering, returns a paginated result.

methods.name: findAutoAssignByTenantId
methods.description: Finds auto-assign rule chains for a tenant, with optional search text filtering, returns a paginated result.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndTypeAndRootIsTrue
methods.description: Finds the root rule chain for a tenant and specific type.

methods.name: countByTenantId
methods.description: Counts the number of rule chains for a tenant.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndTypeAndName
methods.description: Finds rule chains by tenant ID, type, and name.

methods.name: getExternalIdById
methods.description: Retrieves the external ID for a rule chain by its internal ID.

methods.name: findRuleChainsByTenantIdAndResource
methods.description: Finds rule chains associated with a specific resource within a tenant, returning entity info.

methods.name: findRuleChainsByResource
methods.description: Finds rule chains associated with a specific resource, returning entity info.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of rule chain fields after a given ID, limited by a specified limit.

methods.name: findRuleChainsByTenantIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds rule chains by tenant ID and a list of rule chain IDs.
